clauses.text: This Leave and License Agreement is made and executed at Bengaluru on this 1st day of August 2026 between Mr. R. Prakash (hereinafter called the "Licensor") and Ms. A. Menon (hereinafter called the "Licensee"). WHEREAS the Licensor is the absolute owner of Flat No. 304, Green Meadows Apartments, and has agreed to grant the Licensee a licence to occupy the said premises on the following terms:
clauses.explanation: Standard clause; no risk indicators found.

clauses.heading: Leave And License Agreement
clauses.text: TERM: The licence is granted for a period of eleven (11) months commencing from 1st August 2026. This agreement shall be automatically renewed for a further period of eleven months unless the Licensee gives written notice at least ninety (90) days before expiry.

findings.title: Automatic renewal
findings.explanation: The agreement renews by itself unless someone gives notice in time. Miss the window and you can be bound for another term, often at a higher rent.
findings.ask: Put the notice deadline in your calendar, or ask for renewal only by mutual written agreement.

clauses.explanation: The agreement renews by itself unless someone gives notice in time. Miss the window and you can be bound for another term, often at a higher rent. Key numbers: 3 month(s), 11 month(s).
clauses.ask: Put the notice deadline in your calendar, or ask for renewal only by mutual written agreement.

clauses.heading: License Fee
clauses.text: The Licensee shall pay a monthly license fee of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) on or before the 5th day of every month. Upon renewal the license fee shall be increased by 15% over the last paid license fee.

findings.title: Steep rent increase
findings.explanation: The rent rises by more than 10%, above the increases customary on renewal (often around 5-10%).
findings.ask: Negotiate a lower cap (e.g. 5%) or a fixed rent for the first renewal.

clauses.explanation: The rent rises by more than 10%, above the increases customary on renewal (often around 5-10%). Key numbers: ₹25,000, 15%.
clauses.ask: Negotiate a lower cap (e.g. 5%) or a fixed rent for the first renewal.

clauses.heading: Security Deposit
clauses.text: The Licensee has paid an interest-free security deposit of Rs. 2,50,000/- to the Licensor. The deposit shall be refunded after the Licensee vacates the premises, after deducting any amounts due, at the sole discretion of the Licensor.

findings.title: Decided at the landlord's sole discretion
findings.explanation: This clause lets one side decide on its own, with no objective standard and no way for you to challenge the decision.
findings.ask: Replace 'sole discretion' with an objective test (e.g. 'reasonable, documented costs') or require mutual agreement.

findings.title: Deposit is about 10.0× the monthly rent
findings.explanation: The security deposit equals roughly 10.0 months of rent. That is a lot of your money held by the landlord, and it is harder to recover in a dispute. For reference, India's Model Tenancy Act, 2021 suggests a cap of two months' rent for residential premises (it applies only in states that have adopted it).
findings.ask: Negotiate the deposit down to 2-3 months' rent, or ask for interest on the excess.

clauses.explanation: This clause lets one side decide on its own, with no objective standard and no way for you to challenge the decision. The security deposit equals roughly 10.0 months of rent. That is a lot of your money held by the landlord, and it is harder to recover in a dispute. For reference, India's Model Tenancy Act, 2021 suggests a cap of two months' rent for residential premises (it applies only in states that have adopted it). Key numbers: ₹250,000.
clauses.ask: Replace 'sole discretion' with an objective test (e.g. 'reasonable, documented costs') or require mutual agreement.

clauses.text: A sum equivalent to one month's license fee shall be deducted from the security deposit towards painting and cleaning charges at the time of vacating, irrespective of the condition of the premises.

findings.title: Automatic deductions from deposit
findings.explanation: A fixed charge (often painting or cleaning) comes out of your deposit whatever condition you leave the home in. Repainting after normal use is usually ordinary wear and tear.
findings.ask: Make painting/cleaning deductions conditional on actual damage, with receipts.
findings.evidence: deducted from the security deposit towards painting

findings.title: Repainting regardless of condition
findings.explanation: You must pay for repainting whatever state the home is in. Repainting after normal use is usually the owner's cost.
findings.ask: Make repainting conditional on damage beyond normal wear and tear.

clauses.explanation: A fixed charge (often painting or cleaning) comes out of your deposit whatever condition you leave the home in. Repainting after normal use is usually ordinary wear and tear. You must pay for repainting whatever state the home is in. Repainting after normal use is usually the owner's cost. Key numbers: 1 month(s).
clauses.ask: Make painting/cleaning deductions conditional on actual damage, with receipts.

clauses.heading: Lock-In
clauses.text: There shall be a lock-in period of eleven months. If the Licensee vacates during the lock-in period, the Licensee shall pay the license fee for the remaining lock-in period and the security deposit shall stand forfeited.

findings.title: Deposit can be forfeited
findings.explanation: The landlord can keep the whole deposit as a penalty, not just the cost of actual damage or unpaid rent.
findings.ask: Limit deductions to unpaid rent and documented repair costs; remove forfeiture.

findings.title: Lock-in period
findings.explanation: You cannot leave during the lock-in without a penalty. If your plans change (job, studies, family), you may still owe money.
findings.ask: Keep the lock-in short and make it apply to both sides equally.

findings.title: Pay rent for months you don't live there
findings.explanation: If you leave early you must pay rent for the rest of the term, which can be a large lump sum.
findings.ask: Cap early-exit cost at one month's rent, or allow you to leave once a replacement tenant is found.
findings.evidence: pay the license fee for the remaining lock-in

clauses.explanation: The landlord can keep the whole deposit as a penalty, not just the cost of actual damage or unpaid rent. If you leave early you must pay rent for the rest of the term, which can be a large lump sum. Key numbers: 11 month(s).
clauses.ask: Limit deductions to unpaid rent and documented repair costs; remove forfeiture.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: The Licensor may terminate this agreement at any time without assigning any reason by giving fifteen (15) days notice to the Licensee. The Licensee may terminate this agreement by giving three (3) months notice in writing to the Licensor.

findings.title: Can be ended without reason or notice
findings.explanation: The tenancy can be ended at any time or without a reason, leaving you exposed to sudden loss of your home.
findings.ask: Require a written notice period (at least 1 month) and limit landlord termination to specific breaches.

findings.title: Very short notice to vacate
findings.explanation: The landlord can end the tenancy with under a month's notice, which is very little time to find a new home.
findings.ask: Ask for at least one month's written notice.
findings.evidence: Licensor may terminate this agreement at any time without assigning any reason by giving fifteen (15) days

findings.title: You must give more notice than the landlord
findings.explanation: You have to give about 90 days' notice to leave, but the landlord only has to give about 15 days. The termination terms are tilted against you.
findings.ask: Ask for the same notice period for both parties.

clauses.explanation: The tenancy can be ended at any time or without a reason, leaving you exposed to sudden loss of your home. The landlord can end the tenancy with under a month's notice, which is very little time to find a new home. Key numbers: 15 day(s), 3 month(s).
clauses.ask: Require a written notice period (at least 1 month) and limit landlord termination to specific breaches.

clauses.heading: Late Payment
clauses.text: If the license fee is not paid by the due date, the Licensee shall pay a late fee of Rs. 500/- per day of delay along with interest at 3% per month on the outstanding amount.

findings.title: High monthly interest on late payment
findings.explanation: Interest of 2% or more per month is 24%+ per year, far above normal lending rates.
findings.ask: Ask for a modest flat late fee or a low annual interest rate.

findings.title: Daily penalty
findings.explanation: Charges that accrue every day add up quickly, especially if a payment is delayed by a bank holiday or an emergency.
findings.ask: Ask for a grace period and a capped one-time late fee.

clauses.explanation: Interest of 2% or more per month is 24%+ per year, far above normal lending rates. Charges that accrue every day add up quickly, especially if a payment is delayed by a bank holiday or an emergency. Key numbers: ₹500, 3%.
clauses.ask: Ask for a modest flat late fee or a low annual interest rate.

clauses.heading: Repairs
clauses.text: The Licensee shall carry out all repairs and maintenance of the premises at her own cost, including normal wear and tear, plumbing, electrical and structural repairs.

findings.title: You pay for all repairs
findings.explanation: Making you responsible for every repair includes major and structural problems that are normally the landlord's job.
findings.ask: Split responsibilities: minor day-to-day repairs for you, major/structural repairs for the landlord.
findings.evidence: Licensee shall carry out all repairs

findings.title: Structural repairs on you
findings.explanation: Structural repairs (roof, walls, main plumbing or wiring) are expensive and are normally the owner's responsibility.
findings.ask: Make structural and major repairs the landlord's responsibility.
findings.evidence: Licensee shall carry out all repairs and maintenance of the premises at her own cost, including normal wear and tear, plumbing, electrical and structural

findings.title: Charged for normal wear and tear
findings.explanation: You can be charged for the natural ageing of the home from ordinary use, which tenants usually aren't liable for.
findings.ask: Add 'normal wear and tear excepted'.

clauses.explanation: Making you responsible for every repair includes major and structural problems that are normally the landlord's job. Structural repairs (roof, walls, main plumbing or wiring) are expensive and are normally the owner's responsibility.
clauses.ask: Split responsibilities: minor day-to-day repairs for you, major/structural repairs for the landlord.

clauses.heading: Inspection
clauses.text: The Licensor or his agents shall be entitled to enter and inspect the premises at any time without prior notice. The Licensor shall retain a duplicate set of keys to the premises.

findings.title: Landlord can enter without notice
findings.explanation: The landlord can come into your home whenever they like, which affects your privacy and security.
findings.ask: Require at least 24 hours' written notice except in a genuine emergency.
findings.evidence: Inspection: The Licensor or his agents shall be entitled to enter and inspect the premises at any time

findings.title: Landlord keeps a key
findings.explanation: The landlord keeps a key to your home, so entry is possible without you knowing.
findings.ask: Ask that keys be used only in emergencies or with your consent.
findings.evidence: retain a duplicate set of keys

clauses.explanation: The landlord can come into your home whenever they like, which affects your privacy and security. The landlord keeps a key to your home, so entry is possible without you knowing.
clauses.ask: Require at least 24 hours' written notice except in a genuine emergency.

clauses.heading: Guests
clauses.text: The Licensee shall not allow any guests or visitors to stay overnight in the premises without the prior written permission of the Licensor.

findings.title: Restrictions on guests
findings.explanation: You need permission to have guests, which reaches into your private life in your own home.
findings.ask: Limit restrictions to long-term additional occupants, not ordinary visitors.
findings.evidence: Guests: The Licensee shall not allow any guests or visitors to stay overnight in the premises without the prior written permission

clauses.explanation: You need permission to have guests, which reaches into your private life in your own home.
clauses.ask: Limit restrictions to long-term additional occupants, not ordinary visitors.

clauses.heading: Indemnity
clauses.text: The Licensee shall indemnify the Licensor against all losses, claims and damages of whatsoever nature arising in connection with the premises. The Licensor shall not be liable for any loss, theft or injury suffered by the Licensee or her guests.

findings.title: Open-ended scope
findings.explanation: Words like 'whatsoever' or 'irrespective of the cause' make the obligation unlimited, including situations that are not your fault.
findings.ask: Limit the obligation to losses caused by your own negligence or breach.

findings.title: Broad indemnity
findings.explanation: You agree to cover the landlord's losses or claims broadly, possibly including ones you did not cause.
findings.ask: Limit the indemnity to losses caused by your negligence or breach of the agreement.
findings.evidence: indemnify the Licensor against all losses

findings.title: Landlord excluded from all liability
findings.explanation: The landlord is not responsible for losses or injuries, even ones caused by poor upkeep of the building.
findings.ask: Add an exception for loss caused by the landlord's negligence or failure to repair.
findings.evidence: Licensor shall not be liable for any

clauses.explanation: Words like 'whatsoever' or 'irrespective of the cause' make the obligation unlimited, including situations that are not your fault. You agree to cover the landlord's losses or claims broadly, possibly including ones you did not cause.
clauses.ask: Limit the obligation to losses caused by your own negligence or breach.

clauses.heading: Taxes
clauses.text: Property tax and all municipal taxes in respect of the premises shall be borne by the Licensee during the term of this agreement.

findings.title: Owner's taxes passed to you
findings.explanation: Property/municipal tax is normally the owner's liability; this clause shifts it to you.
findings.ask: Ask that property and municipal taxes stay with the owner.
findings.evidence: Property tax and all municipal taxes in respect of the premises shall be borne by the Licensee

clauses.explanation: Property/municipal tax is normally the owner's liability; this clause shifts it to you.
clauses.ask: Ask that property and municipal taxes stay with the owner.

clauses.heading: Default
clauses.text: In case of any default, the Licensor shall be entitled to disconnect the electricity and water supply and change the locks of the premises.

findings.title: Self-help eviction
findings.explanation: The landlord may cut utilities, change locks or remove your belongings. Evicting a tenant normally requires due legal process, not self-help.
findings.ask: Delete this clause entirely.

clauses.explanation: The landlord may cut utilities, change locks or remove your belongings. Evicting a tenant normally requires due legal process, not self-help.

clauses.heading: Amendment
clauses.text: The Licensor may modify the rules and conditions of this agreement at any time by written intimation to the Licensee.

findings.title: Terms can be changed one-sidedly
findings.explanation: One party can change the agreement after you sign it, so the deal you agreed to may not be the deal you get.
findings.ask: Add: 'No change to this agreement is valid unless made in writing and signed by both parties.'

clauses.explanation: One party can change the agreement after you sign it, so the deal you agreed to may not be the deal you get.
clauses.ask: Add: 'No change to this agreement is valid unless made in writing and signed by both parties.'

clauses.heading: Overstay
clauses.text: If the Licensee fails to vacate on expiry, she shall pay double the license fee for every month of overstay.

findings.title: Penalty of multiple times the rent
findings.explanation: Overstaying or a breach costs double (or more) the rent, a penalty far larger than the landlord's actual loss.
findings.ask: Replace with ordinary per-day rent for any overstay agreed in writing.

clauses.explanation: Overstaying or a breach costs double (or more) the rent, a penalty far larger than the landlord's actual loss.
clauses.ask: Replace with ordinary per-day rent for any overstay agreed in writing.

clauses.text: The Licensee hereby waives all rights to object to any deduction made from the security deposit.

findings.title: You give up legal rights
findings.explanation: The clause asks you to waive rights or remedies you would otherwise have. Waivers like this are hard to undo once signed.
findings.ask: Strike the waiver, or limit it to a specific, named situation.

clauses.text: The premises shall be used only for residential purposes by the Licensee and her immediate family. The Licensee shall not sublet or assign the premises.

clauses.text: Disputes arising under this agreement shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Bengaluru.
